name: io.github.iadnanmukhtar/hadithdb
title: HadithDB
description: Research Quran, translations, tafsir, hadith, scholarly commentaries, Sirah, and Islamic history.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: Discover book aliases, authors and reader URLs across the public library. A translation renders Quran wording, a tafsir explains an ayah, and a sharh explains a hadith. Hadith collections include virtual compilations with their own numbering. Sirah and history contain narrative passages. Use lookup_book for a known alias.

type.description: Filter by catalog role. Use trans for translations or sharh for hadith commentary. A work may have multiple roles.

query.description: Part of an alias, Arabic or English title, short name, or author.

limit.description: Maximum number of books on this page.

offset.description: Start at zero, then pass next_offset with the same filters.

tools.name: lookup_book
tools.description: Resolve an exact catalog alias to its work, author, roles and reader URL. To read text, use lookup_quran_ayah for Quran, lookup_quran_translation for a translator, lookup_tafsir for an exegete, lookup_hadith_detail for a numbered hadith or historical passage, and lookup_hadith_commentary for an entry ID from shuruh search.

alias.description: Exact work alias from list_books, for example bukhari.

tools.name: lookup_quran_translation
tools.description: Read a specific translator’s English rendering of one ayah. Use list_books with type trans to choose the edition. Preserve the translator’s attribution when citing or comparing wording.

translation.description: Exact alias of a work listed under the trans role.

surah.description: Surah number containing the requested ayah.

ayah.description: Ayah number within the surah. Zero is valid only in Surah 1.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search published HadithDB blog articles by words or phrases in their public titles and text. Results are editorial discovery candidates, distinct from Quran, hadith, tafsir and shuruh. Verify any cited reports with the source lookup tools. Use lookup_blog_post for complete article text.

query.description: Words to match in the published article title or body.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return on this page.

cursor.description: Pass the preceding page’s next_cursor with the same query and filters.

tools.name: lookup_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieve a published blog article by its ID from search_blog. Preserves its author, canonical URL and public Markdown. Editorial interpretation is not independently authenticated scripture. Default bounds text to 6000 characters; full returns the complete article.

id.description: Published post ID returned by search_blog.

response_profile.description: Return up to 1500 characters, 6000 characters, or the full article respectively.

tools.name: list_hadith_commentaries
tools.description: Use this to discover available hadith commentary works (shuruh), authors and aliases before selecting a source. These are commentary works, not the underlying hadith collections. Catalog presence does not guarantee coverage of a particular report.

query.description: Filter works by alias, title or author in Arabic or English.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return on this page.

offset.description: Zero-based start position. Use next_offset from the preceding page.

tools.name: search_hadith_commentary
tools.description: Use this for scholarly explanations, procedural details and disagreements, including when answering how to perform worship or researching Quranic concepts. Searches shuruh across collections. Results preserve the commentary work and associated hadith separately. Retrieve exact entries with lookup_hadith_commentary and verify reports with lookup_hadith_detail.

query.description: Arabic or English words to match.

source.description: Optional exact commentary alias from list_hadith_commentaries.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return on this page.

cursor.description: Pass next_cursor from the preceding page with the same query and filters.

tools.name: lookup_hadith_commentary
tools.description: Retrieve an exact scholarly commentary entry by ID from commentary search or a hadith’s research inventory. Preserve its author and work attribution. Default bounds each language to 6000 characters; full retrieves all indexed text.

id.description: Commentary entry ID from search_hadith_commentary or a hadith research inventory.

response_profile.description: Return up to 1000 characters per language, 6000, or all indexed commentary respectively.

tools.name: research_islamic_topic
tools.description: Start here for a substantive topic or worship question. Pass the full question, 1–4 short Arabic or English search phrases (for example استخارة and istikharah), and any known principal hadith references. The tool searches the six major hadith collections and the wider corpus, Quran, tafsir, shuruh and published articles. It follows selected hits to exact texts, attached explanations and linked reports within a call and time budget. Read each evidence entry’s relationship and status, then inspect coverage and next_steps. For a material gap, narrow the query or open the exact record in this turn. Cite Quran wording and hadith with their references and attributed grades. Attribute interpretations and disagreements to the named scholar. Treat articles as editorial context and verify their scripture quotations.

question.description: Full question, including the practice, scope or disputed point. The queries field drives retrieval.

queries.description: Short concept search phrases, preferably including Arabic equivalents. Do not pass the entire natural-language question as a search phrase.

hadith_references.description: Known exact principal report references to prioritize and verify, e.g. bukhari:1166. Do not invent references or translate source numbers across collections.

depth.description: Research breadth, independent of the final answer length. All depths have time and source limits.

tools.name: research_quran_ayah
tools.description: Use this for explanations of Quran ayahs. Retrieves the exact ayah and major available tafsirs (default Tabari, Ibn Kathir, Qurtubi; more at deep depth), then searches supplied concepts in Quran, tafsir, hadith, shuruh and published blog articles (editorial context). If concepts are omitted, read the returned ayah/tafsirs, derive short grounded concept phrases, and call again with concepts without asking the user. Search matches are conceptual candidates, not proof a hadith directly explains this ayah. Verify relevant source text before synthesis. Respect explicitly requested tafsir sources.

surah.description: Surah number containing the requested ayah.

ayah.description: Ayah number within the selected surah. Zero is valid only in Surah 1.

concepts.description: Short concept search phrases, preferably including Arabic equivalents. Do not pass the entire natural-language question as a search phrase.

hadith_references.description: Known exact principal report references to prioritize and verify, e.g. bukhari:1166. Do not invent references or translate source numbers across collections.

tafsirs.description: Optional requested source names/aliases; overrides the default source selection.

depth.description: Research breadth, independent of the final answer length. All depths have time and source limits.

tools.name: lookup_quran_page
tools.description: Get a Mushaf page by page number, or find the first page containing a surah and ayah. Returns edition information, ayah/word boundaries, all overlapping passage and subsection headings, stored introductions, and a page overview assembled from those headings. The overview is not a separately authored summary or Quran text. Ayahs and passages may continue across pages.

page.description: Printed Mushaf page number. Supply either page or a surah and ayah pair.

ayah.description: Ayah within the selected surah whose first Mushaf page should be returned.

response_profile.description: Per-heading introduction limits: compact 1000 characters per language, default 6000, full all stored text. Titles and ranges are always preserved.

tools.name: list_quran_sections
tools.description: List a surah’s passage (level 2) and subsection (level 3) headings in hierarchy order, with exact section identities, Arabic/English titles, stored introductions, ayah ranges, and URLs. These editorial headings and introductions are distinct from Quran text. Follow next_offset for more results.

limit.description: Maximum number of headings to return.

offset.description: Zero-based start position. Use next_offset from the preceding page.

response_profile.description: Per-heading introduction limits: compact 1000 characters per language, default 6000, full all stored text. Titles and ranges are always preserved.

tools.name: lookup_quran_passage
tools.description: Get an exact Quran passage by surah and section number, optionally subsection; or find the passage containing a surah and ayah. Returns stored bilingual headings/introductions, exact ayah ranges, parent/subsection relationships, and Mushaf links. A section number is an editorial passage identifier, not an ayah number. Use list_quran_sections to discover section IDs.

section.description: Passage number within the surah from list_quran_sections.

subsection.description: Child heading number within the specified section.

ayah.description: Ayah 0 is valid only in surah 1.

response_profile.description: Per-heading introduction limits: compact 1000 characters per language, default 6000, full all stored text. Titles and ranges are always preserved.

tools.name: list_quran_reciters
tools.description: List available Quran audio reciters and their aliases. Use this to resolve a requested reciter. Juhani is the default.

tools.name: get_quran_audio
tools.description: Get an audio URL and exact ayah timing segments for a Quran passage by a selected reciter (default: Juhani). Returns playback data, not a command that starts playback. Use surah, ayah_from, and optionally ayah_to for an inclusive range. For portions spanning surahs, call once per surah and play in order. Use list_quran_reciters for available names and aliases. Clients must seek to start_ms and stop at end_ms; the URL points to the full surah.

surah.description: Surah number containing the requested ayah.

ayah_from.description: First ayah to play within the selected surah, inclusive.

ayah_to.description: Inclusive last ayah; defaults to ayah_from. For a whole surah, specify its first and last ayah.

reciter.description: Reciter alias or exact catalog name. Defaults to Juhani.

tools.name: lookup_quran_ayah
tools.description: Retrieve the exact Arabic text, English translation, headings, and canonical URL for one Quran ayah. For explanations of its meaning, use research_quran_ayah to consult major available tafsirs and research its concepts in hadith and shuruh before synthesizing.

ayah.description: Ayah number. Ayah 0 is valid only for Surah 1.

tools.name: search_quran
tools.description: Search Quran Arabic text and English translations by words or phrases. Use lookup_quran_ayah for an exact reference.

query.description: Words or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not modify it.

offset.description: Deprecated numeric pagination offset. Prefer cursor.

sort.description: Choose best text matches first or order results by Quran reference.

tools.name: list_tafsirs
tools.description: Find available HadithDB tafsir sources and aliases. Use this to resolve an author or title before a tafsir lookup.

query.description: Optional author, title, language, or alias filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of catalog entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not modify it.

tools.name: lookup_tafsir
tools.description: Read a named exegete on one ayah. A commentary may cover a range of ayahs. Cite the work and its returned passage separately from the Quran wording.

tafsir.description: Alias, author, short name, or title, such as ibn-kathir.

surah.description: Surah number containing the requested ayah.

ayah.description: Ayah number to explain. Zero is valid only in Surah 1.

response_profile.description: Controls response size. Compact shortens long commentary, default balances context and size, and full returns all stored text.

max_chars.description: Optional explicit character cap per language, overriding the selected response profile.

tools.name: search_tafsir
tools.description: Discover passages in Quran exegesis by Arabic or English terms, optionally within one exegete’s work. Follow a result with lookup_tafsir using its source and ayah.

query.description: Words or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not modify it.

offset.description: Deprecated numeric pagination offset. Prefer cursor.

tafsir.description: Optional tafsir alias, author, short name, or title.

sort.description: Choose best text matches first or order results by Quran reference.

tools.name: search_hadith
tools.description: Search Arabic or English hadith, sirah, and history text, optionally within selected book aliases or virtual book groups. Use the sirah or history scope to search every book whose type is sirah or history.

query.description: Words or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not modify it.

offset.description: Deprecated numeric pagination offset. Prefer cursor.

books.description: Optional HadithDB book aliases or groups such as sahihayn, sixbooks, ninebooks, sirah, or history. Either sirah or history searches all books of both historical types.

tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search Arabic or English passages across all HadithDB History and Sirah books, including Yasir Qadhi’s Seerah. For historical follow-ups, include the event, person, or place from the conversation in the query. Use lookup_hadith_detail to read a returned reference in context.

query.description: Words or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching records per page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Do not modify it.

offset.description: Deprecated numeric pagination offset. Prefer cursor.

tools.name: lookup_hadith_detail
tools.description: Read a numbered hadith, virtual compilation entry, Sirah narrative, or History passage. Use the exact collection alias and number returned by search. Hadith records include Arabic and English wording, chain, headings, grades and a reader URL where available. If the exact numbered reference is absent, tries the unsuffixed number and letter-suffixed variants before reporting not found; returned records retain their actual references. Complete scholarly metadata and provenance are available with response_profile: "full". Every profile includes all stored grader opinions, narrators with reliability and death information, attached commentary identities, and related report references only (no narration text). For worship instructions or scholarly explanations, use research_islamic_topic and the commentary tools before answering.

reference.description: Reference such as bukhari:1, muslim:1907, or ahmad:1.6.

response_profile.description: Compact returns the core record plus research metadata and is the default. Default adds bounded attribution, narrator, grading, reference, and commentary metadata. Full explicitly returns all stored provenance and metadata.
